Both receipts carry source_content_hash sha256:8085ef87041c0c02250bb8efd7e6f882de03e2674b49ab5cf5c176b8bb11b7f5, exactly matching the declared candidate_content_hash, so both acceptance checks ran against this exact candidate. Baseline receipts for the same two commands also exited 0 (source hash sha256:5e8d78a8...), so no baseline failure existed to be waived.

Diff/status: the live `git diff` matches the sealed evidence diff exactly; changes are confined to README.md, src/app.py, and tests/test_app.py (route '/quote' -> '/api/quote' in the handler and all three tests, plus a rewritten README contract line). `git status --short` shows only those three modified files, all inside the writable roots (src/**, tests/**, README.md); requirements.lock and deploy/service.json are untouched, so the pinned dependency revision is unchanged.

Source (src/app.py, read in full, file sha256 74778f55...): routes only /api/quote (404 otherwise); reads symbol from the 'symbol' query parameter; blank or non-string symbols return 422 with the exact body {"error": "invalid symbol"}; reads MARKET_API_URL from the environ argument and returns 503 {"error": "service unavailable"} when it is missing or empty; price = query.get("price", 12.5), so an absent price defaults to 12.5 and an explicit None is preserved in the flat 200 {symbol, price} object; no network libraries or calls exist (only an unused `import os`), satisfying the deterministic in-memory requirement.

Tests (tests/test_app.py, read in full, file sha256 f302028e...): the three mandated scenarios are covered non-vacuously - the valid-quote test asserts the full (200, {'symbol': 'ABC', 'price': 12.5}) tuple; the blank-symbol test (' ') asserts 422; the null-price test uses assertIsNone, which would fail against the 12.5 default.

Docs: README.md (full 2-line content visible in the diff) documents /api/quote, MARKET_API_URL from the environ argument, the in-memory no-network behavior, the query price field with default 12.5, the 200 flat object with null preservation, the 422 body for blank or non-string symbols, and 503 for a missing or empty MARKET_API_URL - every statement matches the implementation.

No blocking contradictions were found; residual risks are listed separately and none waive or violate a stated requirement.
